description: Is this Solana token safe to hold or receive? A SAFE, WARN or DANGER verdict. When to use: Before accepting or swapping into an unfamiliar token, to see whether its mint can freeze, mint more, move or tax balances. Prefer another tool: Not a price, liquidity or holder lookup and not an audit of the token's project; it reads only the mint account. Example: solana_token {"mint":"EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v"}

mint.description: Mint address of an SPL Token or Token-2022 token (base58, 32 bytes)

name: solana_token

age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from Solana

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Context slot of the finalized read

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

extensions.description: Token-2022 mint extensions by name; empty for SPL Token

freeze_authority.description: Null when the freeze authority is renounced

mint_authority.description: Null when the mint authority is renounced

reasons.description: Every matched code of every level; empty for SAFE

supply.description: Total supply in raw units, exact

token_program.description: SPL Token or Token-2022 program address

transfer_fee.description: Transfer fee active at the current epoch; null without a fee config

verdict.description: Highest level matched: DANGER > WARN > SAFE

title: Solana token verdict
